title: Enhancing Repository-Level Code Completion with Reinforcement Learning in Real-World Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2611.07510v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) for code, which closely aligns with the practical needs of real-world software development, has sparked growing attention in repository-level code completion. However, existing Code LLMs present challenges in focusing on suitable contexts from the repository and in deeply reasoning about cross-file dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework for repository-level code completion. To better understand both in-file and cross-file contexts, we employ identifier-driven intent recognition to capture completion intent, thereby improving the model's performance in real-world scenarios. To enhance cross-file reasoning, we propose a reward-driven completion learning to effectively reward in complex repository completion scenarios. translated_title: 在真实场景中利用强化学习增强仓库级代码补全
translated_abstract: 面向代码的大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，与真实世界软件开发的实际需求高度契合，引发了人们对仓库级代码补全日益增长的关注。然而，现有的代码大语言模型在从仓库中聚焦合适的上下文以及深入推理跨文件依赖方面存在挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的面向仓库级代码补全的强化学习框架。为了更好地理解文件内和跨文件上下文，我们采用标识符驱动的意图识别来捕获补全意图，从而提升模型在真实场景中的表现。为了增强跨文件推理能力，我们提出了奖励驱动的补全学习，以在复杂的仓库补全场景中提供有效的奖励。为了引导大语言模型完成符合预期功能和仓库上下文的代码补全，我们引入了一种sel……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种面向仓库级代码补全的强化学习框架，通过标识符驱动的意图识别捕获补全意图、结合奖励驱动的补全学习增强跨文件推理能力，从而显著提升真实场景下的代码补全效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes a novel reinforcement learning framework for repository-level code completion that combines identifier-driven intent recognition with reward-driven completion learning to enhance in-file/cross-file context understanding and cross-file reasoning, improving performance in real-world scenarios.
